title: COPPA Rule takes effect
detail: FTC Children's Online Privacy Protection Rule: verifiable parental consent for collecting data from children under 13.

title: Shutdown law (Youth Protection Act) takes effect
detail: Online games blocked for under-16s between midnight and 6 am.

title: Shutdown law relaxed
detail: Parents may request that their child be exempted from the midnight game curfew.

title: Mandatory content-blocking on minors' smartphones
detail: KCC mandate: carriers must provide harmful-content blocking (e.g. Smart Sheriff) on phones of under-19s; parents notified if disabled.

title: Office of the Children's eSafety Commissioner established
detail: Created under the Enhancing Online Safety for Children Act 2015 (cyberbullying complaints scheme).

title: Harmful Digital Communications Act 2015 commences
detail: Royal assent 2 July 2015; civil and criminal remedies for harmful digital communications.

title: GDPR / Data Protection Act 2018: digital age of consent 13
detail: UK set the Article 8 age at 13.

title: GDPR applies: digital age of consent 16
detail: Ireland set the Article 8 age at 16 (Data Protection Act 2018).

title: Personal Data Act (GDPR via EEA): digital age of consent 13
detail: Section 5 sets 13; exact commencement date not verified here.

title: Law 4624/2019 implements GDPR: digital age of consent 15
detail: Parliament passed the bill 27 Aug 2019 (publication date not verified).

title: Victoria bans phones in state schools
detail: From Term 1 2020 (announced June 2019); state-level policy.

title: Age Appropriate Design Code (Children's code) in force
detail: Conformance expected from 2 September 2021.

title: Children's code: end of transition period
detail: Online services expected to conform.

title: National Assembly votes to abolish the shutdown law
detail: Youth Protection Act amendment.

title: Shutdown law abolished
detail: Replaced by an opt-in game-time selection system.

title: Online Safety Act 2021 commences
detail: Expanded eSafety powers (adult cyber-abuse; Basic Online Safety Expectations; industry codes).

title: Online Safety and Media Regulation Act 2022 signed into law
detail: Announced 16 Dec 2022.

title: Coimisiún na Meán established
detail: New media and online safety regulator.

title: Utah Social Media Regulation Act signed
detail: First US state law requiring parental consent for minors' accounts; preliminarily enjoined 10 Sep 2024.

title: Digital Services Act applies to very large online platforms
detail: VLOPs/VLOSEs must comply (incl. Art. 28 minors' protection and systemic-risk duties).

title: Online Safety Act 2023 receives Royal Assent
detail: Duties phased in by Ofcom codes.

title: Queensland 'away for the day' school phone ban
detail: From Term 1 2024; other states and territories agreed similar limits in government schools.

title: Digital Services Act fully applicable
detail: All intermediary services; not yet incorporated in the EEA (Norway).

title: Phones away for the day in all state schools
detail: Rules must be in place by first day of Term 2 2024.

title: Kids Online Safety Act passes the Senate 91-3
detail: Not enacted (House did not pass).

title: EU AI Act enters into force
detail: Prohibitions apply from 2 Feb 2025; general-purpose AI obligations from 2 Aug 2025.

title: Phones must stay in bags during school
detail: From the start of the 2024-25 school year; suspensions for breaches.

title: Online Safety Code adopted by Coimisiún na Meán
detail: Applies to video-sharing platforms; Part A ~Nov 2024.

title: Government proposes social media age limit of 15
detail: Raise digital consent age from 13 to 15; consultation then parliament.

title: Online Safety Amendment (Social Media Minimum Age) Act 2024
detail: Passed 29 Nov 2024; obligations commence 10 Dec 2025.

title: TikTok divest-or-ban deadline
detail: Law upheld by the Supreme Court; US joint venture formed 22 Jan 2026.

title: AI Act prohibited practices apply
Online Safety Act illegal-content duties enforceable
Kids Wallet introduced
detail: State app for age assurance and parental control under the national strategy.

title: Government moves forward with absolute age limit of 15
detail: Consultation proposal; not enacted.

title: Amended COPPA Rule effective
detail: Compliance required by 22 Apr 2026.

title: Commission guidelines on protection of minors (DSA Art. 28)
Online Safety Code Part B applies
detail: Includes age assurance for adult content on video-sharing platforms.

title: Online Safety Act child-safety duties and age checks enforceable
Law bans smartphones in classrooms
detail: Takes effect from the March 2026 school semester.

title: Under-16 social media minimum age in force
detail: Age-restricted platforms must take reasonable steps to prevent under-16s having accounts.

title: Classroom smartphone ban in effect
Under-15 social media ban announced
detail: Planned to take effect at the beginning of 2027.
